decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:36.0pt;text-align:justify;
text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<b><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Principle
of Development<o:p></o:p></span></b></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:36.0pt;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold">The
proposed development would result in the creation of a standalone 1-bedroom,
1-person dwelling on a garage and/or backland site within an area with a Public
Transport Accessibility Level (PTAL) of 2. The proposal would not accord with
the Council's housing mix objectives and has failed to demonstrate a
comprehensive approach to the development potential of the wider surrounding
land. The development would therefore represent the piecemeal redevelopment of
an individual garage and/or backland plot, contrary to the objectives of
comprehensive development and effective use of land. As such, the proposal
conflicts with Policies HO1 and GR10 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021–2041),
Policies H1 and H2 of the London Plan (2021), and the objectives of the
National Planning Policy Framework.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:36.0pt;text-align:justify;
text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Arial;
mso-bidi-font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></span><!--[endif]--><b><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Future
Occupier Amenity</span></b><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-bidi-font-weight:bold"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:36.0pt;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold">The
proposed dwelling would fail to provide a high-quality standard of
accommodation for future occupiers by reason of its constrained internal
arrangement, lack of demonstrated internal storage provision, failure to
demonstrate compliance with the minimum floor-to-ceiling height expectations of
London Plan Policy D6, limited outlook, inadequate private outdoor amenity
space and the absence of sufficient information to demonstrate satisfactory
residential living conditions within the converted garage structure. The
proposal would therefore fail to provide a high standard of residential
accommodation and would be contrary to Paragraph 135 of the National Planning
Policy Framework, Policy D6 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy GR1(C) of the
Harrow Local Plan (2021–2041).<o:p></o:p></span></p>
description: Conversion of detached garage to self contained studio flat; single storey front extension; cycle and bin stores; external alterations
